desc: Translate S into its ordered rooted forest (stack parse) and model the operation as reversing a consecutive block of sibling subtrees while applying the recursive flip F to each; show F is an involution preserving the unordered structure.

Prove reachability: single-subtree flips (k=1) give F, and adjacent siblings A,B can be swapped via block-reverse on [A,B] then flips of each resulting subtree, so all child permutations plus flips are achievable; hence reachable set = all ordered rooted forests with the same underlying unordered forest.
Implement the O(N log N) tree DP: canonical ids via sorted child-id tuples, and v = fact[k]·∏invfact[n_t]·∏v_t^{n_t} mod 998244353 bottom-up, applied to a virtual top-level forest; print the answer.
Confirm edge cases and complexity (O(N log N), N ≤ 5000) consistent with the accepted solution.
